'''Iguanodon''' is a large herbivorous [[dinosaur]] from the Cretaceous era. While [[extinct]] in real life, its appearance in-game depends on the option chosen when [[World generation|creating a world]]. Even though they are generally benign, adult iguanodons are the size of an [[elephant]] and may prove to be dangerous if somehow [[Agitation|agitated]].

Contrary to what one may expect, iguanodons are not [[grazer]]s and do not require a [[pasture]] to survive.

Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] iguanodons for their ''thumb spikes''.
